system.name: MoC-System
system.one_liner: a fault-tolerance system for sparse Mixture-of-Experts model training that reduces checkpoint size via partial-expert checkpointing

content.key_idea: Under ZeRO-2 DP+EP with 3 ranks, non-expert layers (Atten, FFN) are replicated identically on every rank while each rank holds a distinct expert, and the optimizer states similarly mark which parts are stored (1) vs. absent (0) per rank.

evidence: As depicted in Figure 1(a), EP can be viewed as an aug- mentation of Data Parallelism (DP)
each expert within an MoE layer is allocated to a distinct DP rank
model parameters are replicated across each DP rank

summary: Figure 1 illustrates the model state layout under MoC-System's target training configuration: ZeRO-2 data parallelism combined with expert parallelism (DP=3, EP=3) across three ranks. Panel (a) shows model parameters: each rank (Rank0-2) holds identical copies of the non-expert layers (Atten, FFN) but a distinct expert (Expert1-0, 1-1, 1-2), illustrating that expert parallelism assigns one expert per DP rank while replicating everything else. Panel (b) shows the corresponding optimizer states using the same rank layout, with 0/1 flag boxes marking which state entries are actually stored (partitioned, as in ZeRO-2) versus replicated per rank. Together the two panels set up the background problem MoC-System addresses: efficiently checkpointing this mixed replicated/sharded state without redundantly saving identical non-expert layers or every rank's own expert.
summary_zh: 图1展示 ZeRO-2 DP+EP（DP=3, EP=3）下三个 rank 的模型状态布局：(a)模型参数中非专家层（Atten、FFN）在各 rank 复制，而每个 rank 持有不同专家；(b)优化器状态以 0/1 标记各 rank 实际存储的状态分片。
